content:
My name is Songyin Wu. Currently I am a research assistant in Microsoft Research Asia, supervised by Jongyoo Kim and Xin Tong. My research mainly focuses on rendering and inverse graphics, especially in material modeling and objects relighting.
I obtained my Bachelor’s degree from Peking University, supervised by Prof. Baoquan Chen.
